history.prompt:
Wide overhead photograph of a long dark matte desk. Across the whole width, evenly spaced from left to right, four small objects: a phone lying face-down, a closed black notebook, a single brass key, and a blank cream card with a small brass paperclip. Everything sits in a single horizontal row in the middle of the frame with generous empty desk above and below. No printed or written text anywhere.

Visual style: calm, precise, premium. A long matte near-black desk surface with fine film grain, one soft warm brass-toned light from the left. Palette: near-black, mist white, deep ink-blue, warm brass tones and at most ONE small gold accent. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.
